verdict: Nvidia's revenue more than tripled to a record $22.1B as Data Center sales jumped 409% on AI demand — and it kept $12.3B as profit, about 56 cents of every dollar.

kpis.label: EPS (GAAP)
kpis.note: split-adjusted; $4.93 as reported before the June 2024 10-for-1 split; non-GAAP $0.52 split-adjusted ($5.16 as reported)

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: AI data-center chips and networking — Hopper demand for training and running generative AI drove a 409% jump to a record $18.4B.

segments.name: Gaming
segments.note: GeForce graphics cards for gamers and AI PCs — RTX 40 series sales, including the new SUPER cards, lifted revenue 56%.

segments.name: Professional Visualization
segments.note: Workstation graphics for designers and engineers; up 105% YoY.

segments.name: Automotive
segments.note: Chips and software for cars and robots — down 4% YoY, even as more carmakers adopted the DRIVE platform.

segments.name: OEM and Other
segments.note: Smaller chip sales to other manufacturers; up 7% YoY.

opex.name: Research and development
opex.note: Spending to design future chips and AI software.

opex.name: SG&A
opex.note: Sales, marketing and day-to-day running costs.

otherDetail: Interest income $294M and $260M of other income (mostly gains on investments in non-affiliated companies), less $63M interest expense, net.
follow100Note: Data Center alone is $83.26 of every $100 Nvidia takes in. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
footerNote: Segments are revenue by market platform, as NVIDIA reports them.

takeaways.title: Data Center became the company
takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit a record $18.4B, up 409% from a year ago and 27% from the prior quarter — about $83 of every $100 Nvidia took in — as cloud builders raced to train and run generative AI on Hopper chips.

takeaways.title: Margins reached record levels
takeaways.text: A 76.0% gross margin — up from 63.3% a year ago — turned the sales surge into $12.3B of net income, up 769% from a year ago.

takeaways.title: Guidance pointed higher still
takeaways.text: Nvidia guided next-quarter revenue to $24.0B, plus or minus 2%; full-year fiscal 2024 revenue reached $60.9B, up 126%.
